back: System software that manages the hardware and resources and provides services and a user interface.
Process, memory, file, security, and hardware (input-output) management.
System software that does a maintenance task, for example formatting, virus checking, defragmenting, compression or back-up.
Rearranging the blocks of each file so it is stored in one piece, reducing head movement on a magnetic disk.
Copies only the files changed since the last back-up; to restore, the full back-up and all later increments are needed.
A collection of tested routines that programs can call.
Dynamic Link Library: loaded when needed and shared by several programs.
CLI: typed commands, fast for experts, little memory. GUI: windows, icons and menus, easy for beginners.
Saves memory because one copy is shared, and an update reaches all programs; but programs fail if it is missing or incompatible.
